event_summary: A yellow smiley-marked ball on a black circular platform stays in place while its visible markings gradually turn out of view.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a yellow ball with black smiley markings sitting on a black circular platform on a wooden tabletop beside a vertical mirror. Across the video, the ball remains on the platform at the same scene location, while the smiley markings shift from facing the camera to the side and then become no longer visible on the front-facing surface. The mirror shows a reflected view of the same platform and ball throughout. The camera view remains steady.

reasons: The ball, platform, tabletop, mirror, and cord are clearly visible.
The visible change of the ball markings continues across the sequence rather than beginning from a distinct separate onset.
